verdict.rationale: Docs and a verified runtime probe show skills install as ordinary editable markdown files (SKILL.md with frontmatter) copied into the repo under `.claude/skills/...`, explicitly framed as 'ordinary files you own and can edit' with no proprietary lock-in or silent updates, and the CLI exposes an `-a` agent-target flag implying portability across harnesses beyond Claude Code. Missing for 10: a hands-on demonstration of actually carrying the same SKILL.md folder into a second, different harness (e.g., a non-Claude agent) to confirm cross-agent portability in practice.
